mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_like l WHERE l.post_id = p.post_id) AS like_count
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_post WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}

SELECT p.post_id, p.stock_code, s.stock_name, p.title, p.content, u.login_id AS author_login_id, p.created_at,
FROM board_post p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN stock_info s ON s.stock_code = p.stock_code WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_post WHERE post_id = #{postId})
SELECT user_id FROM board_post WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_post (stock_code, user_id, title, content) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content})
